==<span style="color:red">'''NOTICE'''</span>==
The [https://web.archive.org/web/20201022051828/https://www.youtube.com/c/ILMxLAB ILMxLAB] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20201019181344/https://www.youtube.com/c/ILMVFX ILMVFX] YouTube channels have since been merged into a single channel&mdash;[https://www.youtube.com/c/ILMVFX Industrial Light & Magic]&mdash;including the entirety of both channels' videos. With that in mind, every video prior to the merge and going forward will be covered using only this template.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below for the required usage and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use. 

<code><nowiki>{{ILMYouTube|video=|text=|date=|quote=|parameter=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|video}} Use the alphanumeric part of the url that comes after "<code>watch?v=</code>" in the url. Please do not include anything other than this.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the video.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} Date the Youtube video was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} To include a quote. 
*{{Para|parameter}} To create a link to a channel's playlist, use <code>|parameter=playlist?list</code>.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp|YouTube}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{ILMYouTube|DM_XwzOK_98|Light & Magic &amp;#124; Official Trailer &amp;#124; Disney+|archivedate=20220707161928}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{ILMYouTube|DM_XwzOK_98|Light & Magic &#124; Official Trailer &#124; Disney+}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{ILMYouTube|video=fvOw-MAT_p4|text=Age of Jedi - Original Score by Joseph Trapanese &amp;#124; Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge|archivedate=20201221032906}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{ILMYouTube|video=fvOw-MAT_p4|text=Age of Jedi - Original Score by Joseph Trapanese &#124; Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge}}

<hr />
For a playlist:

<code><nowiki>{{ILMYouTube|parameter=playlist?list|video=PLD1LJWlLIBcaJqzTLmXsSNqwh2uF_tl8e|text=Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge - Original Scores|archivedate=20201203000446}}
</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{ILMYouTube|parameter=playlist?list|video=PLD1LJWlLIBcaJqzTLmXsSNqwh2uF_tl8e|text=Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge - Original Scores}}
